family.description: RNaseH domain of the pPIWI_RE PIWI/Argonaute module. pPIWI_RE is found in a conserved three-gene island that also contains a DinG-type helicase and an REase nuclease. This three gene island is predicted to form a conflict system which targets R-loop formation of invasive plasmids during plasmid replication [[cite:PUB00091016]].
family.name: RNaseH domain of pPIWI_RE
